items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: Outside of the Paddock Lounge, you got Miss Valenti. She didn't want you to play nothing slow.

ctx.x: What was it like playing on Burden Street?

Well, it was all right. Nobody worried us. They hardly requested any numbers. They left us playing what we wanted to play. Outside of the Paddock Lounge, you got Miss Valenti. She didn't want you to play nothing slow. And that's what got George upset. He said, I'm going to play some slow numbers because I ain't going to be a racehorse in those numbers after every number we play. He said, I'm going to mix them up. But she didn't say nothing about it. So we stayed there for, oh, for a long time. A little less than…
Is it harder work playing on Burden Street than anywhere else?
